A member or staff user exceeding a granular role, or acting on someone who outranks them
A used intent, an intent for another action, a proof from another session, a replayed ceremony
A staff enrolment by someone who holds only the mailbox
Learning whether an account exists from a public answer
Session fixation, cookie scope, CSRF and the origin gate
Reaching a Better Auth endpoint the allowlist does not name
An invitation taken by an unconfirmed address
Giving more than one holds; removing the last admin
A forged Access identity at Fin Admin
A leaked service database login writing a critical table
